description: This Java class is a REST controller for email operations within a web application, providing endpoints for listing inbox, sent, drafts, trash, archived emails, retrieving email details, searching emails, composing, drafting, and updating email flags. It handles HTTP requests, performs user authentication, and delegates business logic to an email service.

classes.name: EmailController
classes.description: REST controller for email operations (inbox, sent, drafts, trash, archived, search, compose, flags).

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current User object based on the provided Authentication object.

methods.name: inbox
methods.description: Returns paginated inbox emails for the current user.

methods.name: sent
methods.description: Returns paginated sent emails for the current user.

methods.name: drafts
methods.description: Returns paginated draft emails for the current user.

methods.name: trash
methods.description: Returns paginated trash emails for the current user.

methods.name: archived
methods.description: Returns paginated archived emails for the current user.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific email owned by the current user.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a full-text search across subject and body for emails of the current user.

methods.name: compose
methods.description: Composes and sends an email, returning its details.

methods.name: draft
methods.description: Saves an email as a draft and returns its details.

methods.name: updateFlags
methods.description: Updates flags (read, star, archive, delete) for a specific email.
